evidence: Each card shows a module badge (UI Components, Core System, API, Data Layer, Authentication). Clicking "API" narrowed list to exactly 5 API docs; clicking "All" restored all 19 docs.

Selecting "REST API Design Guidelines" shows title (h1), description, module badge API, date 2024-01-15, version v2.3.0, Content Sections (REST Principles, Endpoint Naming Conventions, Pagination & Filtering) and Related Documents (4 entries).

Section headers carry a chevron-down icon; expanded "REST Principles" has class rotate-180 with visible body paragraph + reference links, while collapsed "Endpoint Naming Conventions"/"Pagination & Filtering" chevrons are un-rotated with no body paragraph. Indicator state matches visibility.

Clicking "HTTP Methods Guide" link on the collapsed "Endpoint Naming Conventions" section kept h1 = "REST API Design Guidelines" and showed prompt "Please expand the section to access links". After expanding the section, clicking the same link navigated to h1 = "HTTP Methods Guide".

Clicking collapsed "Endpoint Naming Conventions" header restored its body paragraph ("Use nouns for resources...") and its reference link "HTTP Methods Guide" became an active clickable link; chevron rotated to 180.

Clicking "HTTP Methods Guide" reference inside expanded section opened that document; from HTTP Methods Guide's Related Documents list, clicking "REST API Design Guidelines" made it the visible document (h1 changed accordingly).

Collapsing "REST Principles" removed its body paragraph and its reference links reverted to the inactive collapsed state (cursor-not-allowed, opacity-60, click triggers expand prompt); header remained and clicking it again restored body and pointer-active links.
Visited all 19 documents and collected every content-section reference label and related-document entry; no document listed its own title in either list (selfRefs = []).

Search "zzzqqq" → 0 cards with message "No documents found / Try adjusting your search or filter criteria". Search "JWT" + UI module → also 0 cards with the same message. Clearing search restored 3 UI docs; clicking All restored all 19.

Graph SVG has exactly 19 g.graph-node elements (one per document). Node stroke colors group by module and match the legend swatches (API cyan hsl(187,85%,53%)=rgb(33,213,237), Auth purple, Data Layer green, UI amber, Core red). 19 <line> edges = the 19 unique related-document pairs derived from all documents.

Clicking the "Component Library" node gave it a visible selection indication (extra animate-pulse-glow ring r=28 + stroke-width 3). Zoom In ×2 → label "140%", transform scale(1.4); Zoom Out → "120%", scale(1.2); Reset View → "100%", translate(0,0) scale(1).

Graph renders all 19 documents from all 5 modules as nodes plus 19 connection lines matching all related-document pairs. After Reset View (100%, translate 0,0) node bounding box x 390–934, y 20–584 fits entirely within the 1280×643 SVG viewport, i.e. complete graph in view.

issue: Graph node selection does not open the document view; a manual tab change is required
actual: Clicking the "Component Library" node on the Knowledge Graph only highlighted the node (pulse-glow ring). The main area still showed only the graph canvas, controls and legend — no document title/sections/related list appeared anywhere, and the active tab stayed on Knowledge Graph. Only after manually clicking the Documents tab did h1 = "Component Library" appear. The graph view (zoom 140%, node selection) was preserved for return.

evidence: Header nav exposes three buttons: Documents, Knowledge Graph, Favorites (with count). Switched among all three repeatedly; each rendered its own content (document list+detail, graph canvas with controls/legend, favorites list).

With doc "Component Library" (Component Structure collapsed, Prop Patterns expanded) and graph zoom 140% + node selected: switching Documents→Graph→Favorites→Documents kept h1="Component Library", the same per-section expand/collapse states in every tab, and graph zoom 140% / transform scale(1.4) with the node still highlighted. Persisted store shows graphState {zoom:1.4, pan:{0,0}} and per-doc sectionStates. Caveat: drag-panning the canvas never changed pan from (0,0) (both Playwright drag and dispatched mouse sequences), so only the zoom half of view state could be exercised.

issue: Documents module filter leaks into the Favorites view, hiding favorited documents
actual: Persistence/count/markers work: after page reload favorites were retained (JWT Authentication, Accessibility Standards) with nav badge "Favorites 2"; the badge incremented 1→2 immediately on starring, and markers survived sorting (Title→Last Updated) and module filtering (AUTH). BUT the Favorites view is filtered by the module chosen in Documents: with AUTH selected it listed only JWT Authentication (Accessibility Standards missing); with DATA selected it listed 0 items and showed "No favorites yet - Star documents to add them to your favorites" while the nav badge still read "Favorites 2". The Favorites view has no module filter control of its own, so favorites become unreachable there until the filter is cleared in Documents.
